get_feature_reader: get a feature reader class by type such as logmel, hubert, w2v2, or cpc
get_feature_iterator: get a generator function that iterates over speech features from a manifest file
get_features: extract speech features from audio files listed in a manifest and return as numpy arrays
get_and_dump_features: extract speech features from a manifest and save them to a numpy file on disk
review_utils_functions: review the utils module functions for feature extraction from pretrained speech models
